_doc: Policy for dynamic mine-network (game/fleet/mine_net.py). Auto-rotates miners across unsaturated belts (>=15% floor), matching fitted tools, prioritizing reserve/needs.tsv shortages, skipping full reserves, and stamping instant cooldowns on floor breach.
_zero_note: 2026-11-25 (Trinity, Suggi directive preserving Zero anti-copper fix): kept market_min_bid=10 against bloated copper/nitrogen, restored allow_lawless_for_deficit=true (calm 0-pirate/6h lawless deficit belts like iron/silicon/uranium), lawless_min_tier=1 for T1+ upgraded miners, needs_max_priority=3 (matches priority_resources silicon_ore), high_value_market_min_bid=25 (fury/phase crystals, plasma/chlorine gas), max_station_jumps=6, xp_fallback_max_jumps=8 (penalizing bloated junk) to eliminate 71% no-belt stalls.
_zero_note_pirates: 2026-11-25 (Zero, requests ENT-534): request_escort_for_pirate_deficits false while Military's escort lane stands stopped (errors ENT-202): a belt in a system the dispatcher's pirate stop closes is never offered, a deficit too; mine_net reads the dispatcher's pirate record (sightings and members' lines), not the store's observations alone.
_zero_note_dropoffs: 2026-11-25 05:54 UTC (Zero, orders ENT-092 block ZERO: store where it can be taken out): allow_bursar_dropoffs false. 63 of the 121 newest claims stored their iron in the miner's own storage at Bursar hubs outside deposit_stations, most at stations of other players, where no give route or receiver of ours stands. A dry run of the assignment on the live store with it off: 129 of 130 miners still placed (124 iron, 5 fluorine deficits), every deposit at one of the 12 stations of the list; the way grows from a median of 4 to 5 jumps belt plus station.
_trinity_500_note: 2026-11-26: Enabled 5-wing specialization (3A Precision, 3B Bulk, 3C Deep-Core/Rad, 3D Gas, 3E Ice), allow_xp_fallback=true for fast P10, 5-empire deposit hubs, and automatic Target-system-not-found cooldown.
_trinity_opt_note: 2026-11-27: Soft lawless preference (1.35x lawless / 0.75x safe-zone except >=40 cr or <3% scarce), tiered 6J/8J/10J fuel-optimal range, adaptive 1/2/3 belt caps, 5%/0.2%/15u depletion floors.
_3b_bulk_opt_note: 2026-11-28 (Trinity, Suggi approved): Pivoted 3B Ore Bulk off 1 cr overstocked iron/copper/carbon_ore (376k+ held; rivals dump @ 1-5 cr) onto titanium/silicon/nickel/lead/aluminum_ore via bulk_deficit_min_bid=20, overstock guard (>=100k & <12 cr), 7J/6J standard reach, 8J/7J scarce, 10J/8J mega, 5% standard / 0.2% scarce floor.
